rows.text: Sat, Nov 14 · data as of 8:48 AM ET · stocks at Friday's close
Crypto Fear & Greed fell to 13, its lowest since Jul 1, as Bitcoin slid 2.8% to $67,197.

rows.short: Bitcoin fell 2.8% to $67,197 and Solana 6.6% to $75.54.
rows.text: Bitcoin fell 2.8% to $67,197 and Solana 6.6% to $75.54. Hot inflation data and bets on a December Fed rate hike pushed up the dollar and bond yields; the 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.125%. Bitcoin dropped under its 200-week average, near $68,000, and over $1.3 billion of crypto futures bets were wiped out in a day.

rows.short: NVIDIA fell 2.0% Friday and 12.75% for the week.
rows.text: NVIDIA fell 2.0% to $162.85 Friday, 12.75% for the week after Jensen Huang quit as CEO. The S&P 500 fell 0.4%, Coinbase 2.3% and Tesla 1.8%. Starship Flight 15 reached orbit, but SpaceX called off the booster catch; SpaceX shares fell 0.6%.

rows.short: Bitcoin and Coinbase read Very low at 13, NVIDIA at 14.
rows.text: Bitcoin and Coinbase read Very low at 13 and lead the buy lists; NVIDIA reads 14. Solana reads 21, just above the line. Games score 51 and Pokémon 43. In the movers sweep, Pokémon Box for GameCube rose 14.4% to $1,505.55.

Very low stock readings came before above-average 30-day gains in the tests. Caution: it moves with crypto, which is still falling.

rows.name: Extreme fear has come before gains
rows.short: Bitcoin rose in 30 days after 54 of 71 past days with Fear & Greed at 13 or under.
rows.text: After past days with crypto Fear & Greed at 13 or under, Bitcoin was higher 30 days later 54 times in 71, by 5.2% on average, against 56% of all days and 3.1% since Nov 2023. Those days bunch into a few spells, so the count overstates the evidence. Checked on the fng and btc rows in history.json.

rows.name: Five down weeks for Bitcoin
rows.short: Bitcoin's Sunday price fell 5 weeks running, from $86,480 to $75,814.
rows.text: Bitcoin's Sunday price has fallen five weeks in a row, from $86,480 on Oct 4 to $75,814 on Nov 8, and it is $67,197 this morning. The only other run this long since 2023 lasted six weeks and ended Mar 1, 2026; 30 days later Bitcoin was up 3.8%. Checked on the daily Bitcoin rows in history.json.

rows.name: Stock fear run ends
rows.short: CNN's stock gauge read 37, 36, 40 and 39 after 22 readings at 34 or under.
rows.text: CNN's gauge read 34 or under at all 22 readings from Oct 14 to Nov 9, then 37, 36, 40 and 39. The two longer runs in the stored history ended Apr 24, 2025 and Apr 9, 2026; 30 days after each, the S&P 500 fund was up 6.0% and 8.5%. Checked on the daily CNN and VOO rows in history.json.

rows.name: Big drops have tended to bounce
rows.short: Tesla was higher 30 days later after 10 of its 13 past drops of 8% or more.
rows.text: Tesla's 10.9% fall on Nov 5 was its 14th one-day drop of 8% or more in three years of data; it was higher 30 days later after 10 of the 13 before. It has since risen 13.6%, to $390.22 at Friday's close.

rows.name: Intuit
rows.text: About 15x forward earnings, sales up 14%, 58% below its 2025 high
rows.risk: Fear that AI tools erode TurboTax and QuickBooks
rows.more_for: Trailing revenue is $21.45B, up 13.9%, and net income rose 18%. At $341.50 it trades near 15x forward earnings, 58% below its July 2025 closing high. It guided fiscal 2027 revenue up 9-10%, added an $8B buyback plan in May and raised its dividend 15%. Q1 results come Nov 19.
rows.more_against: Shares hit a five-year low in May after Intuit cut its TurboTax revenue outlook and announced a 17% workforce cut. Investors fear AI tools could undercut tax and accounting software. Growth guidance of 9-10% is slower than past years.

rows.name: Netflix
rows.text: About 19x earnings, 12-13% sales growth, buying back stock fast
rows.risk: Growth slowing, ad revenue outlook cut, viewers open the app less
rows.more_for: Q3 2026 revenue grew 12% and operating margin rose to 34.6% from 28.2%. It bought back $4.8B of stock in Q3, its largest quarter ever, with $22.3B still authorized. At $63.41 it trades near 19x trailing and 18x forward earnings, about 53% below its June 2025 closing high.
rows.more_against: Netflix cut its 2026 ad revenue outlook to about $2.7B from $3B and trimmed free cash flow guidance to $12.0B. Bloomberg reported users are watching and opening the app less, and layoffs are underway. Q4 guidance of 12% growth led analysts to cut targets, and the stock sits near its 52-week low of $61.39.

rows.name: PDD Holdings
rows.text: About 7x forward earnings; cash near 56% of its market value
rows.risk: Profit falling on price wars; China and Temu tariff risks
rows.more_for: PDD trades at 9x trailing and about 7x forward earnings, with revenue up 10%. A Sept 2026 analysis put cash and short-term investments near $67B, about 56% of today's $119.5B market value. Deutsche Bank upgraded it to Buy around Oct 30.
rows.more_against: Net income fell 6% over the past year and Q2 revenue missed estimates. Competition from Alibaba, JD and Douyin is squeezing margins, and Temu faces new EU parcel fees. Chinese stocks are in a bear market, and the stock has lost about 4% a year over five years.

rows.name: AppLovin
rows.text: Q3 sales up 55%, about 19x forward earnings, half its 2025 high
rows.risk: SEC data probe report, class action; already up 79% since spotted
rows.more_for: Q3 2026 revenue rose 55% to $2.18B, beating the $2.07B estimate, and EPS of $4.30 beat $4.03. Free cash flow was $1.4B in the quarter, and several banks raised targets (RBC $520, Evercore $540, Goldman $445). Even after a 31% jump on Nov 5, it trades near 19x forward earnings and about 48% below its 2025 closing high.
rows.more_against: The stock is up about 71% from $228.50 in under a week, so a good part of the gain may already be in. A shareholder class action is open (lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 16), and short-seller claims about its data use, plus a 2025 report of an SEC probe, still hang over it. Trailing P/E is now about 24, above the under-20x bar in the original case.

rows.name: Reddit
rows.text: Sales up 62%, about 15x forward earnings, 65% under its 2025 high
rows.risk: US daily users fell 2%; Google AI answers send it less traffic
rows.more_for: Q3 2026 revenue rose 53% to $895M and net income rose 74% to $283M. Trailing revenue is up 62%, and the stock trades near 19x trailing and 15x forward earnings. Weekly active users still grew 16% and revenue per user rose 36%.
rows.more_against: US daily active users fell 2%, the first drop since its 2024 listing, and Reddit warned daily users could fall a low-double-digit percent in Q4 if search referrals keep shrinking. Q4 sales guidance of $1.00B-$1.03B missed the ~$1.05B estimate. Several analysts downgraded it after a 30% one-day drop on Oct 30.

rows.name: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals
rows.text: Product sales up 52%, new $1B buyback, 68% below its 2025 high
rows.risk: Demand growth disappointed; sales at low end of guidance
rows.more_for: Q3 2026 product revenue rose 52% to about $1.3B, led by Amvuttra, and trailing revenue is $5.0B, up 56%. At a $21B market value it trades near 4x sales and 22x forward earnings. It announced a $1B share buyback on Nov 4.
rows.more_against: Management said it is not yet satisfied with demand growth and expects TTR sales at the low end of its $4.2B-$4.5B range. The stock has had two 25%+ one-day drops in three months, several firms downgraded it, and its commercial chief is stepping down. The trailing P/E of 8 is inflated by a $1.9B one-time tax benefit.

rows.name: Boston Scientific
rows.text: About 14.5x forward earnings, 60% below its 2025 high
rows.risk: Third guidance cut this year; warns 2027 growth will be hard
rows.more_for: Trailing revenue is $21.07B, up 8.9%, and net income rose 25.5%. At $42.75 it trades near 14.5x forward earnings, versus a five-year average near 26x. Part of the 2026 cut came from an eight-day production halt after an August cyberattack, which may not repeat, and a WATCHMAN FLX Pro study just met its primary endpoints.
rows.more_against: It cut its 2026 outlook three times, and Q4 sales are guided to fall 1-3%. WATCHMAN sales fell 6% in Q3, a trial showed slightly more ischemic strokes than blood thinners, and about 1.6 million pacemakers are being recalled. It warned 2027 will be tough on China pricing and heart device weakness, and several firms downgraded it.

rows.name: Mineralys Therapeutics
rows.text: FDA ruling Dec 22; cash is ~46% of its $1.35B market value
rows.risk: AstraZeneca's rival drug launched first; slow Medicare access
rows.more_for: The FDA set a Dec 22, 2026 action date for lorundrostat in hypertension, and AstraZeneca's baxdrostat approval in May shows the FDA accepts this drug class. In Launch-HTN, 46% of patients on 50 mg reached office systolic pressure under 130. It held $624.7M in cash at Sept 30, which it says funds the launch into 2028.
rows.more_against: AstraZeneca's drug launched first, and analysts raised worries about rebates and Medicare coverage possibly not until 2028; price and launch metrics are not disclosed. The stock fell from $21.24 to $15.22 between Oct 29 and Nov 5 with no reason given in the news yet. It still owes Tanabe up to $255M in milestones and carries a term loan.

rows.name: Oracle
rows.text: Sales up 22%, about 13.5x forward earnings, 65% below its 2025 high
rows.risk: $169B debt, negative cash flow, new share sales dilute owners
rows.more_for: Trailing revenue is $71.8B, up 21.6%, and net income rose 52%. At $116.10 it trades near 13.5x forward earnings, versus a five-year average near 21x. Management forecasts positive free cash flow in the second half of fiscal 2028 and over $30B in fiscal 2029.
rows.more_against: Total debt including leases reached $169.1B and free cash flow was negative $23.7B in fiscal 2026. S&P cut it to BBB-, one notch above junk, and it is selling $10B of stock and $10B of notes on top of $19.9B of stock sold earlier this year. A report said it dropped a $7B Tencent chip-leasing deal, and the stock fell 6.9% on Nov 5, near its 52-week low of $111.66.

rows.name: Summit Therapeutics
rows.text: Trades 23% below AstraZeneca's $18.36 buy-in; FDA ruling due Nov 14
rows.risk: FDA wants a clear survival win; one drug, no sales yet
rows.more_for: AstraZeneca closed a $2 billion investment on Oct 5 at about $18.36 a share; the stock closed Friday at $14.15. The FDA rules by Nov 14 on ivonescimab with chemo for one kind of lung cancer, and an updated survival analysis cut the risk of death by about a quarter. With $630 million in cash plus AstraZeneca's $2 billion it can run for years, and the HARMONi-3 trial reports by year end.
rows.more_against: Summit's own filing says the FDA wants a clear survival benefit and longer time without the cancer growing may not be enough; the survival result is only borderline. HARMONi-3 missed an early check in April 2026. The stock fell 12% on Nov 5 and rose 15% on Nov 6, with no reason given in the news yet, and it lost $208 million last quarter.

rows.name: Starship ship catch try
rows.short: The ship is due back at Starbase about 4:17 PM ET today for a tower catch.
rows.text: Starship Flight 15 lifted off Friday and reached orbit, but SpaceX called off the booster catch and the booster splashed down in the Gulf. The ship is due back about 4:17 PM ET today for a first tower catch, if its systems check out. A catch or a loss could move SpaceX shares Monday.

rows.name: GTA 6 launch
rows.short: The biggest game launch in years, after two delays.
rows.text: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI comes out Nov 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Take-Two kept the date on its Aug 7 earnings call and called preorders 'unprecedented'. A launch this size pulls gamers' money and time for weeks.
